about_the_game:
Welcome to the shores of The Archipelago!

You take the role of a sea-plane delivery pilot, with the task of bringing warmth, connection, and care to a sunlit island community. Fly your sea-plane between sparkling seas and open skies, delivering packages that carry stories of love, family, and friendship. Along the way, you’ll meet the quirky locals of each island, uncover hidden treasures, and learn more about your grandfather whose steady hands and big heart once guided the same delivery route.

Features:

  • Fly a responsive seaplane that glides through the air and across the water.

  • Meet charming island residents, each with their own stories to share.

  • Collect hidden treasures scattered across The Archipelago.

  • Deliver packages that connect lovers, families, and local businesses.

  • Discover the story of Ray, your gruff but loving grandfather.

  • Explore a handcrafted open world packed with a variety of welcoming islands, each with its own personality and challenges.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit or Windows® 11 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-4770 or AMD Ryzen™ 5 1400
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Soar across the sunlit Archipelago in your trusty delivery seaplane. Explore diverse islands, meet charming locals, and deliver packages by sea and sky in this short cozy adventure.
